property_summary: After any call to setOwner, the owner state variable must equal the argument passed to setOwner; the buggy version sets it to msg.sender instead, so the owner will not match the argument when msg.sender is the original owner.
After a non-owner calls setOwner (which reverts), owner must remain unchanged; the buggy version also reverts but incorrectly modifies owner to msg.sender in that reverted call.

For any caller, a successful call to setOwner updates owner to the argument; the buggy version allows a non-owner to change owner, violating the invariant that only the original owner can change the owner.
After any call to setOwner, if the caller is not the current owner, the owner state variable must remain unchanged; the buggy version violates this by allowing a non-owner to change the owner.
